newsitem.title: GERMANY: Global One wins Volvo data contract.
newsitem.headline: Global One wins Volvo data contract.

text.p: Global One, the joint venture of Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and Sprint Corp, said on Tuesday it has won a contract to carry global data communications for Sweden's Volvo group.
The contract was awarded by Volvo unit Volvo Data Inc to supply data communication services to the corporation's "World Class Services" internal communications network.
"The major condition for being asked was our global presence," said Lars-Erik Larsson, area manager for Global One in Gothenburg, Sweden, in a statement.
Global One is an international joint venture to supply global communications services to multinational corporations.
Its main rivals are the Concert venture of British Telecom and MCI Communications of the United States and the World Partners alliance lead by AT&T Corp.
Volvo Data network manager Joergen Karlsson said the company planned to create a global information network for the Volvo corporation's operations.
"We believe that Global One is a supplier which can meet our demands for availability and high quality," he said.
Global One will connect Volvo communications hubs in Sweden, Belgium, Singapore, Britain and the United States.

Daily communications traffic on the network will range from electronic mail to data transmission services in product management and include frame relay connections, X.25 data communications, local area network interconnection and managed bandwidth services.
